## Model Description (Grok 4.20 (Non-Reasoning))
Grok 4.20 (Non-Reasoning) is xAI's API model variant designed for fast multimodal generation without exposing a deliberate reasoning workflow. It accepts text and image inputs, supports text output, function calling and structured outputs, and provides a 1,000,000-token context window.
